first_failed_attempt_context.caution: First attempt failed, had a different rebuilt set and pre-repair sources/import graph. Its wall time is not a baseline for a speed ratio. Common-name duration changes do not isolate concurrency, cache or source effects.

method: Use the current exact source-hash-matched local import DAG; all cached/unreported nodes have weight0.
Longest prerequisite path uses displayed build-action durations; ties prefer longer full local paths.
Invert pinned Lake formatTime to bound actual millisecond durations. All72 selected rebuilt-path durations exceed10s and are floored, so their1281s displayed sum is a lower bound.

Reported action durations exclude dependency waiting and inherited registered dependency times (JobState.renew). They include compilation and artifact work, and can include interference from concurrent work.
Summed concurrent actions are job-seconds, not wall seconds, CPU seconds or an achievable serial build duration.
There are no start timestamps; completion order does not identify overlapping processes, concurrency level or the hardware cause of long actions.
Candidate zero-cost models are fixed-duration best cases that cannot predict measured improvement; grouping can alter imports, invalidate more proofs per edit and change action durations.

pinned_lake_evidence.claim: buildLean wraps own compile/artifact work in buildAction; recBuildLean waits for presetupJob before calling fetchCore.
monoMsNow starts inside buildAction and accumulates only that action elapsed.
Registering returns job.renew, whose state retains trace and resets buildTime; dependency elapsed is not inherited.
Monitor displays buildTime. >10000ms is integer division by1000; smaller displays use unusual tenths with no carry, so exact inverse intervals are used.
mapM continuation executes after its input task has completed.
